verdict.rationale: Penpot's first-party pages claim native design tokens ("native design tokens" in its Figma comparison, and a Design Tokens feature on the design-systems page), with tokens also mentioned in AI workflows. These are marketing-level mentions only, with no detail on how tokens are managed. Missing for 10: evidence of modes/themes, documented token types (colors, spacing, typography), how tokens are applied across designs, in-depth user-guide docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
